title: Nova Skills Canonical Placement Support, Eligibility & Employer Framework

legalDisclaimer.officialStatement: While Nova Skills provides extensive career support—including resume building, portfolio guidance, mock interviews, and access to industry hiring connections—enrolment does not guarantee a job offer, specific salary package, or employment outcome. Placement success depends on student performance, merit, and interview clearing.
legalDisclaimer.shortDisclaimer: Placement assistance supports career preparation and access to relevant opportunities. Enrolment does not guarantee a job offer, interview, specific salary or employment outcome. Final selection depends on student eligibility, performance and employer requirements.

services: Access to Employer Referral Network Drives
Targeted Referral Sharing for Specialist Openings
Mentor Code/Design Feedback on Final Deliverable
Skill Positioning Guidance for CV & LinkedIn
limitations: No individual recruiter forwarding or interview scheduling

safeguards: Strictly zero placement assistance or employer forwarding
Parent/Guardian consent required for all enrollment and interactions

eligibilityCriteria.name: Curriculum Completion
eligibilityCriteria.requirement: 100% completion of core syllabus modules with minimum 80% verified attendance.

eligibilityCriteria.name: Capstone Project Quality
eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Submission of all mandatory production capstone projects approved by mentor.

eligibilityCriteria.name: Practical Assessment & Viva
eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Achieving >= 70% in practical evaluation and passing mentor viva defense.

eligibilityCriteria.name: ATS Resume Readiness
eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Completion and approval of an ATS-compliant, one-page verified resume.

eligibilityCriteria.name: Recruiter Portfolio Assets
eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Clean, public GitHub repository, Behance portfolio, or live web deployment.

eligibilityCriteria.name: Mock Interview Completion
eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Participation in and completion of at least one formal 1-on-1 mock interview.

eligibilityCriteria.name: Professional Ethics
eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Truthful representation of qualifications and punctual attendance at scheduled interviews.

tierA_formal_partners.description: Companies with executed MoU or formal campus recruitment agreements.

tierB_referral_network.description: Regional agencies and startups that share active vacancy notices with Nova Skills.

tierC_employment_sectors.description: The 6 verified industry sectors whose workflows Nova Skills courses prepare learners for.
